content.name: Supreme Sneak
entries: Starting at 9th level, you have advantage on a Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) check if you move no more than half your speed on the same turn.

content.name: Supreme Sneak
entries: You gain the following Cunning Strike option.

entries.name: Stealth Attack (Cost: 1d6)
entries: If you have the {@action Hide|SRD52} action's {@condition Invisible|SRD52} condition, this attack doesn't end that condition on you if you end the turn behind {@variantrule Cover|SRD52|Three-Quarters Cover} or {@variantrule Cover|SRD52|Total Cover}.
